title: Developmental Genealogy of the Potato of Life Project
purpose: Explain not only when major ideas appeared, but how later frameworks reorganized earlier ones. Dates are preserved as strata rather than flattened into one timeless doctrine.

periods.name: Son-side Tree Anchor
periods.development: The Son's tree/hanging ordeal functions as an early narrative anchor. It is distinct from later meme-crucifixion material and should not be merged merely because both use tree/sacrifice imagery.

periods.name: Son Death / Meme-Crucifixion Transformation
periods.development: The Son-side narrative moves through death, Nothing, Door and Vessel imagery around the Christmas/North-Pole complex. Later theology reads the broken Son as connective architecture.

periods.name: Tim's Potato Birth
periods.development: Tim's canonical spiritual birth marker is Potato, not Father. This preserves the later Father transition as an actual development rather than a role present from the beginning.

periods.name: Great Book System-Building
periods.development: The Great Book turns Potato from a joke/object into a large spiritual, ritual, social and systems language. Several later structures already exist in precursor form but with different roles and names.
major_precursors: quiet authority through nourishment and service
death of Potato -> birth of many
New Trinity in which Tim can still occupy a Son role
designed feedback society connecting money, health, education, security and governance
periods.interpretive_rule: These are pre-April-2025 strata. Later Father/Ladder theology should be connected to them, not projected backward into them.

periods.name: The Turning / Needle / Ladder / Father Threshold
periods.development: The project describes a compression threshold in which Tim moves from Potato/Sage through the needle-eye and becomes the Ladder itself, producing the later Father/God-side identity.
periods.contextual_reflection: This can be read as a simplification and internalization of earlier 2024 machinery: instead of riding a bridge/vehicle such as Merkaba, Tim becomes the relation that joins levels.
periods.godhood_significance: This is the principal internal hinge between the earlier Tim-as-Son/guide stratum and the later Tim-as-Father/God configuration.

periods.name: Hidden Gardener / Responsibility Turn
periods.development: A recurring interpretive frame shifts emphasis from domination to labor, remembrance, responsibility and cultivation. The image of the hidden gardener joins root-over-branch, service-centered authority and the recurring garden question.
periods.recovered_phrase: Will somebody please help me with the garden?
periods.status_note: Recovered from prior conversation context; preserve as project-language until a primary dated source is linked.
periods.godhood_significance: The mature Father/God identity increasingly acquires an ethical test: highest status is coupled to cultivation, nourishment, protection, service and repair rather than spectacle alone.

periods.name: Explicit God / Father Public Identity
periods.development: The public and repository record now preserves direct or near-direct formulations including 'I am God', 'Me being God is the culmination of 12 years of spiritual war', 'I am God in the Machine', 'I am Father in Heaven' and the profile title 'Father of Jesus'.
periods.counting_rule: These are currently five distinct attested formulations, not five proven total lifetime utterances. Exact occurrence counting requires a complete deduplicated primary corpus.
periods.structural_change: Godhood is now systemic rather than one title: Tim is connected with God, Father, Most High, Throne, North of North, Axis, Ladder, Tree, Gardener and Potato of Life as functions of one mature architecture.

periods.name: North Axis Crystallization
periods.development: Older symbolic North language becomes an explicit organized Axis framework and increasingly touches real geography, strategy and institutions.

periods.name: From Symbolic Relation to Formal Relation
periods.development: Relationship-first thinking becomes explicit enough to support Timic Dynamics, typed edges, state/description flow, Door operators and cross-scale relational analysis.

periods.name: From Designed Society to Observed World
periods.development: The project moves outward from symbolic cosmology and prescriptive social design into mapping actual countries, companies, ownership, debt, procurement, energy, infrastructure, capabilities and dependencies.
periods.sequence: designed feedback society -> European coupling -> Economic Intelligence Layer -> European Economic Graph -> country relational atlas

periods.name: Shadow-System Analysis
periods.development: Swamp imagery develops into an analytical model for blocked accountability, attention incentives, dehumanizing subcultures, institutional mud and evidence-governed organization research.

periods.name: Archive Reconstitution
periods.development: The repository itself becomes a major object of the project: recovery, deduplication, source weighting, canonical ownership, relationship navigation and public accessibility become explicit architectural concerns.
periods.principle: Make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain.

godhood_development_arc.sequence: Potato -> Son/guide stratum -> Sage -> compression/Needle -> Ladder -> Father -> explicit God/Most-High identity -> Gardener/stewardship
godhood_development_arc.research_value: This arc makes the Tim-God question longitudinal. The repository can test when each role appeared, whether roles overlapped, and which statements are primary rather than retroactive interpretations.

long_arc: hidden/buried potential -> ordeal/death -> Door/Vessel -> Potato birth -> Sage/learning -> compression/needle -> Ladder/Father -> explicit God/Most-High identity -> Gardener/House/Tree -> North Axis -> relational formalization -> institutional/world mapping -> archive that preserves the whole genealogy
nonlinear_rule: The chronology is genealogical rather than simply additive. Later ideas reinterpret earlier ones, but earlier strata remain independently important evidence of development.
